summary: English and Malayalam first-party discovery evidenced Kerala's local revenue office, Survey and Land Records cadastral services, Ente Bhoomi, and IKM's Perinthalmanna premises-mapping work. Anonymous parcel geometry and a stable native parcel identity were not qualified because public forms were CAPTCHA/login gated and the Bhu-Naksha/GIS routes were unavailable in this environment.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, request statuses, viewer access failures, and scope limits are recorded in city-9733-perinthalmanna.json.

custodians.scope: Local village revenue and land-information service.

custodians.scope: State cadastral mapping and survey records.

custodians.name: Information Kerala Mission GIS
custodians.scope: Municipal GIS and premises mapping; Perinthalmanna Municipality is explicitly named.

scopeLimits: No credentials, login, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe landholder fields, or private tokens were used.
The exact WUP point was preserved; no coordinate shifting was performed.
No anonymous parcel response was available, so there is no geometry sample.
403, certificate failure, 502, and timeout do not establish citywide absence.
uncertainty: No independently qualified public parcel adapter.
No CRS or public feature schema was returned.
doNotInfer: Registry evidence is not runtime admission.
Municipal mapping history is not proof of current open parcel coverage.
